known_limitations: allow_paths are declared by the user and cannot be audited for content beyond hashing. A reviewer must inspect them.
Studies are single files in v0. Importing local helper modules is not supported, because the study's directory is not on the allow-list.

The identical-minus check (K2_MINUS_IDENTICAL) detects only exact identity: a minus world that changes data in an irrelevant way, below float resolution, in the wrong direction, or by too little is not detected. In stochastic mode it depends on pairing: a minus world that ignores its declared change but consumes the generator differently from plus is not detected. Read-key recording is shallow: only top-level keys are recorded. UNTESTED can hide a criterion defect: with an identical minus the criterion's own falsifiability is unknown, which is why UNTESTED does not pass the gate.
External programs are hashed by executable and `uses` files only; the libraries they load are not hashed.
On Windows, killing an external program does not kill programs it started.

A criterion's own UNDEFINED outcomes (None, a pattern's UNDEFINED, a command's UNDEFINED) on plus, minus and null count as no claim; K1 makes the verdict UNDEFINED only for failures (exceptions, failed generation, wrong return types, missing components, command errors) or when the criterion abstains on more than half of the plus samples.
K8 leaves pairs with an UNDEFINED side out of its change count; abstentions can therefore hide changes on up to half of the pairs.
non_claims: A FALSIFIABLE certificate does not mean the hypothesis is true or that the study is well designed in every respect.
All checks are relative to the synthetic worlds, premise mutators and controls that the study declares. Weak declarations give weak certificates; the certificate lists them so a reviewer can judge.
The gate does not modify or repair criteria. It only reports.
Generated mutations and suggested declarations are generic; they do not know your domain.
A file world is only as independent as its provenance; a plus world built from the real data makes the plus and minus checks circular.
The leak guard does not cover external programs; a study note lists them.
